cues.en: Well, last week, we showed you how to become a gynecologist.
cues.zh: 上周，我们教大家怎样成为一名妇科医生。

cues.en: week on how to do it, we're going to show you how to play the flute, how to split an atom, how to construct a box girder bridge,
cues.zh: 周我们要教大家怎么做：演奏长笛、分裂原子、建造箱形梁桥，

cues.en: how to irrigate the Sahara Desert and make vast
cues.zh: 灌溉撒哈拉沙漠，还要开垦大片

cues.en: But first, here's Jackie to tell you all how to rid the world of all known diseases.
cues.zh: 不过首先，请杰姬来告诉大家，怎样消灭世界上所有已知的疾病。

cues.en: First of all, become a doctor and discover a marvelous cure for something. And then when the medical profession really starts to take notice of you, you can jolly well tell them what to do and make sure they get everything right so there'll never be any diseases ever again.
cues.zh: 首先，成为一名医生，发明一种神奇的疗法。等医学界真的开始注意到你了，你就可以好好告诉他们该怎么做，确保他们把一切都做对，这样以后就再也不会有疾病了。

cues.en: How to play the flute? Well, here we are. You blow there, and you move your fingers up and down here. Great.
cues.zh: 怎么吹长笛？这就来。你对着这里吹，然后手指在这里上下按动。太棒了。

cues.en: Great. Great, Alan. Well, next week, we'll be showing you how black and white people can live together in peace and harmony. And Alan will be over in Moscow showing us how to reconcile the Russians and the Chinese.
cues.zh: 太棒了。太棒了，Alan。下周，我们将向大家展示黑人和白人如何和平共处、和谐生活。而 Alan 会前往莫斯科，向我们展示如何调解中俄关系。
